title: Portuguese model mistakenly splits URLs into their own sentences
author: busdriverbuddha

comments.author: AngledLuffa
comments.body:
We use a regex for URL which allows certain patterns:

https://github.com/stanfordnlp/stanza/blob/539760cdc5a903de23895db46e5d7c2e1f8f251b/stanza/models/tokenization/utils.py#L198

The issue you're finding is that it accepts `www.example.com`, but doesn't accept `example.com` w/o the `www.`  I suppose it would make sense to add `example.com` and `example.com.TLD` to the stuff it accepts.  Those are unlikely to be false positives

comments.author: busdriverbuddha
comments.body: Ahh, I see! Might I recommend adding some other common suffixes like .org, .net, and .gov?

comments.author: AngledLuffa
comments.body: This should be fixed in the latest release
